Alesi Surgical is a leading innovator in the field of minimally invasive surgery technologies. The company has developed UltravisionTM, the world’s first system that eliminates laparoscopic surgical smoke without the need for gas exchange. Ultravision produces a low-energy electrostatic charge that can significantly improve visibility for surgeons by actively eliminating surgical smoke generated by energy-based surgical cutting instruments. In addition to improved visibility, Ultravision also allows reducing surgery time by almost 20%. Minimizing healthcare professionals’ exposure to surgical smoke is increasingly important worldwide because of health concerns over the risk of long-term expo

claims.tagline: For a better life in buildings
claims.description: Allthings transforms buildings into digital products. The Allthings platform grants users of buildings access to digital services that simplify everyday life, connect people and improve communication. Property owners benefit from an unprecedented level of transparency in buildings, neighborhoods and across entire portfolios. Thanks to the open, modular design of the Allthings platform, third-party services can be integrated as needed, much like an app store for buildings. Originally founded in 2013 in Basel as a spin-off of ETH Zurich, the company now has offices in Basel, Berlin, Frankfurt am Main and Freiburg im Breisgau. Its 60-person team aims to achieve lasting improvements to life in b

claims.founders: Jovan Stojanovic, Stefan Sredojevic, Bogdan Vukobratovic
claims.tagline: We're building the AI hardware industry from scratch
claims.description: Anari AI is building the AI hardware industry from scratch by delivering a new way of designing and using AI chips. It pioneers reconfigurable AI for customers to personalize their infrastructure in just one click; it also enables chip designers to rapidly create and deploy their solutions. Anari’s ThorX is the first chip on the Anari platform that delivers 100x more efficient computing than GPU on 3D/Graph data structures. Anari’s team is global, made up of researchers, machine learning experts, software engineers, and most of the members are PhDs. The company has a global team including advisors from CERN, Berkley, UCLA, and ex VP Software at NVIDIA.

claims.tagline: Next generation treatments for cardiac arrhythmias
claims.description: Arga Medtech is a medtech company developing the next generation non-thermal cardiac ablation systems for the treatment of cardiac arrhythmias. Among the cardiac arrhythmias, Atrial Fibrillation (AF) is today a global epidemic affecting 33 million people world-wide. AF patients have a 5x greater risk of having a stroke and 3x the risk of developing Heart Failure. The company was formed by industry experts, Randy Werneth & David Neale. Arga Medtech has offices in Switzerland (Lausane) and the US (San Diego).

claims.tagline: Non-invasive medical device to treat incontinence
claims.description: Atlantic Therapeutics develops medical devices and the related software, apps and connected health technologies for both professionals and consumers. Their products treat incontinence, sexual health dysfunctions and other associated disorders by strengthening muscles and modulating nerves of the pelvic floor. The first product INNOVO™ is a revolutionary tool to help prevent bladder weakness by actively treating the root cause rather than just the symptoms. It is clinically proven to work, with 93% of users experiencing a significant reduction in leaks after just 4 weeks.

claims.tagline: Global leader in after-sales services for consumer electronics
claims.description: B2X is the leading global provider of end-to-end customer care solutions for mobile and IoT devices. Founded in 2007, B2X helps many of the world’s leading mobile and consumer IoT companies deliver a superior after-sales service experience. The company’s unique positioning is based on its global service partner network and its SMARTCARE Technology platform that connects everything to a digitally integrated customer care ecosystem. With more than 1,000 employees and over 500 trusted partners in 140 countries worldwide, B2X is the premier after-sales service provider for manufacturers, insurance providers, carriers and retailers.

claims.tagline: Drive customer engagement and marketing ROI with personalized cross-channel campaigns in real-time
claims.description: CrossEngage is a SaaS-based Cross-Channel Marketing Platform, combining a Customer Data Platform with Cross-Channel Campaign Management capabilities, easily integrating with current data sources and marketing channels. The company takes care of customer data management, selecting a marketing campaign and channel per user, but leaves the delivery of messages to existing vendors per marketing channel so that existing infrastructure doesn’t need to be replaced. The solution helps mid- to large-sized companies with digital businesses to improve their CRM activities by delivering a consistent communication across all marketing channels.

claims.founders: Dr. Kai D. Kreisköther (CEO), Fabian Kober (COO), Markus Werle (CTO)
claims.tagline: Smart, clean and efficient urban transportation
claims.description: Ducktrain is the automated vehicle technology platform for the urban logistics of the future, helping logistics operators save more than 30% of their operational costs. It is already road-legal in the EU and actively driving on public roads. Automation will be increased stepwise. A Ducktrain is a combination of any leading object (vehicle or person) and one or more automated “”Ducks”” which automatically follow the leading object. Each Duck is equipped with sensors to detect the leading object and virtually couple it to the duck. This allows flexible creation and dissolution of Ducktrain platoons, efficient door-2-door delivery, and improved worker ergonomics.

claims.tagline: New therapy to treat visual field loss
claims.description: EBS Technologies has developed the NEXT WAVE™ system, a unique neurological stimulation system for the treatment of visual impairments like glaucoma and other neurological based visual impairments resulting from stroke or trauma. The system can treat the effects of these impairments and partially restore vision in many patients. The company holds several patents in the EU and the United States and has successfully demonstrated the clinical safety and efficacy of NEXT WAVE. The EBS therapy system is approved for the treatment of visual field loss in accordance with EU regulations as a medical device with a CE mark.

claims.founders: Prof. Dr. Christof Wunderlich, Dr. Michael Johanning, Jan Leisse
claims.description: eleQtron is engaged in the construction and commissioning of breakthrough quantum computers with trapped ions. It is a spinoff of the Chair of Quantum Optics at the University of Siegen. eleQtron has successfully implemented new methods for quantum information processing which eliminate the need for laser light for coherent control of quantum logic operations. Instead, qubits are controlled by radio frequency waves in novel ion processors using our proprietary MAGIC technology (Magnetic Gradient Induced Coupling). These processors enable individual control of qubits with the highest precision as well as of their interaction, and show a clear path towards massive scaling.

claims.founders: Dr. Dorian Scholz (CPO), Dr. Stefan Kohlbrecher (CTO), Dr. Alberto Romay (COO), Marc Dassler (CEO)
claims.tagline: Operating System for fleets of autonomous mobile robots
claims.description: Energy Robotics provides the first software platform for deploying mobile autonomous robot fleets. The SaaS solution unites a robot operating system, a cloud-based fleet management and an AI-driven analytics platform – independent from robot hardware. The robots are used for remote inspection and monitoring in oil&gas, petrochemical, energy, security & surveillance and other industries with harsh or demanding environments. With a Robot-as-a-Service solution, its software platform, together with various hardware from third-party providers, fits diverse customer use cases. Energy Robotics was founded in 2019 by autonomous robot veterans as a spin-off from the Technical University of Darmstadt.

claims.founders: Frank Wendt, Benedikt Schuppli , Stephan D. Meyer , Philipp Von Randow
claims.tagline: FQX is the 1st market-ready solution for eNotes™ built on a banking-grade Blockchain
claims.description: FQX is radically facilitating trade finance & money markets by using eNotes™, a disruptive short-term financing & payment instrument. An eNote™ is an unconditional promise to pay a specific sum to another party at a specific future date. The eNote™ is based on Blockchain technology and can be flexibly sold and transferred to any third party (i.e. an investor). When compared to other financing options, eNotes™ as negotiable instruments outperform through their financial steering capabilities and global transferability.

As demonstrated by lead clinical-stage program ICT01, which has a mechanism of action to simultaneously modulate innate and adaptive immunity, ImCheck’s “first-in-class” activating antibodies may be able to produce superior clinical results as compared to the first-generation of immune checkpoint inhibitors and, when used in combination, to overcome resistance to this group of agents. In addition, ImCheck’s antagonist antibodies are being evaluated as potential treatments for a range of autoimmune diseases. Co-founder of the Mars

Inkitt is a data-driven book publisher

Inkitt is the world’s first data-driven book publisher and has developed an algorithm that can predict bestsellers. Inkitt’s digital library currently holds more than 80,000 stories spanning all genres: romance, fantasy, sci-fi, mystery, thriller and more. Inkitt’s mission is to democratize publishing by putting the power in the audience’s hands: “If readers love it, we publish it.” The company’s algorithm analyses over 1,200 reading behavior dimensions to identify patterns and understand which novels have a strong potential to become future bestsellers. Once a novel is picked up by the algorithm, Inkitt publishes it and also supports the author with cover design and editing services as well

claims.tagline: First real transaction platform for used cars over the net
claims.description: InstaMotion offers a next-generation experience for buying used cars completely online. Extensive, high-quality image material, a quality assessment report by an independent auditor and a test drive video provide a full picture of the vehicle and make an informed online-only decision possible. The car then gets washed, registered to the new owner and delivered to their doorstep free of charge, including a 14-day money back guarantee and a one-year used car warranty that includes wear and tear. The warranty was developed exclusively together with Allianz. InstaMotion is headquartered in Grünwald near Munich and currently offers a range of more than 10,000 cars on its platform.

claims.founders: Moritz von der Linden (Co-Founder), Karl-Georg Schlesinger (Co-Founder), Georg Korn (Co-Founder), Heike Freund (COO)
claims.tagline: Marvel Fusion – Our mission is to enable humankind to access clean, safe & reliable energy by building a laser-driven fusion power plant
claims.description: Marvel Fusion, founded in Munich in 2019, pursues a new and fast-track route to the commercial application of fusion energy to provide zero-emissions unlimited energy to the global markets. Marvel Fusion’s new technology concept is based on highly intense short-pulsed lasers and proprietary fuel targets. Scientists from the Ludwig-Maximilians-University in Munich, the University of Stanford and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) have recently joined forces with Marvel Fusion to bring its fusion concept to fruition. In its next steps, Marvel Fusion will upgrade existing laser systems (2022-2025) to validate its novel technology and to demonstrate the path to net energy gain.

claims.tagline: The global supplier database for strategic sourcing
claims.description: Matchory brings transparency to global supply chains and offers strategic sourcing an automated supplier search. Supplier data is aggregated worldwide, processed and compiled in a unique database. Using state-of-the-art technologies such as artificial intelligence and machine learning, relevant suppliers from all industries can be identified within minutes. Intelligent search algorithms and AI permanently optimize the search and adapt it to the user. Based on +10m structured data profiles, procurement can generate an individual supplier pool and benefit from real-time-access to relevant supplier data points in one central location.

PiCSO® (Pressure-controlled Intermittent Coronary Sinus Occlusion) is designed to improve clinical outcomes in patients affected by Acute Coronary Syndrome or heart failure. PiCSO therapy is used in the cath lab to intermittently increase pressure in the coronary venous system. This leads to improved microcirculatory flow and improved perfusion of the infarcted area, ultimately leading to a smaller residual infarct size after acute myocardial infarction as compared to non PiCSO-treated patients. Decreased residual infarct size after acute myocardial infarction is shown

claims.description: Mostly AI solves one of the biggest challenges organizations are facing today: balancing their need for Big Data & AI innovation with GDPR/CCPA compliance and privacy protection. By generating Synthetic Data, Mostly AI helps organizations to unlock their privacy-sensitive Big Data assets, as their fundamentally new approach to big data anonymization retains all of the valuable information in a dataset, while protecting the privacy of every data subject. This results in completely anonymous data, that is free to use, free to share and free to monetize.

claims.founders: Denis Bastiment, Alain Blancquart, Simon Gazikian
claims.description: MyDataModels develops and markets an automated Machine Learning software platform for domain experts in need to build and run predictive models with no machine learning skills. The platform is powered by a unique mathematical expression engine, inspired by evolutionary algorithms. The engine has removed major roadblocks of this category of algorithms making their commercial use possible. Particularly suited for numerical datasets with a small number of records/samples, commonly known as Small Data, MyDataModels addresses primarily two markets: scientific research and industry.

N26 is Europe’s first Mobile Bank with a full European banking license and is setting new standards in banking. N26 has redesigned banking for the smartphone, making it simple, fast and contemporary. Opening a new bank account takes only eight minutes and can be done directly from your smartphone. Users receive a Mastercard to pay cashless or withdraw cash all around the world. They can block or unblock their card with a simple click and send money instantly to friends and contacts. N26 was founded in early 2013 by Valentin Stalf and Maximilian Tayenthal. In two years N26 has acquired more than 500,000 clients. It operates in 17 countries: Austria, Belgium, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany,

Founded in 2022 by Tim Fronzek, a german entrepreneur, and Felipe Lino, a brazilian bioscientist, the company already represents 8 different nationalities and will launch its first products within the next 12 months.

Onefootball offers a unique platform to connect brands, advertisers and content partners with a fast-growing community.

Our goal is to improve access and outcomes to better treatment at lower costs.

claims.description: Payhawk is a unique platform that enables CFOs and business owners to manage the entire spending lifecycle end-to-end, from the moment an employee requests money, to loading their corporate card with funds, paying and collecting the invoices, to reconciling all transactions in the company accounting software, and finally generating real-time, up to date reports. Payhawk closes the gap between corporate cards and expense management by providing a product that works on top of existing banks.

The company has quickly moved from being a dominant regional leader with culturally relevant titles to a global player, serving cross-platform games with mass appeal. Over 275 million users around the world have installed at least one of the company’s products. Peak Games is funded by Earlybird Venture Capital, Hummingbird Ventures and Endeavor Catalyst. Aquired by Zynga

claims.tagline: Source code management behind the firewall
claims.description: RhodeCode is an enterprise source code management platform for behind-the-firewall Mercurial, Git and SVN. It is open source, secure and provides centralized control over distributed code repositories. Developers get code review tools and custom APIs that work across Mercurial, Git and SVN. Companies get unified security and access controls so that their CTOs can sleep at night. Unlike aging source code management solutions or Git-only tools, RhodeCode provides a modern platform with unified security and tools for any version control system. The platform has been built for highly secure, behind-the-firewall enterprise environments with sophisticated user management and common authentication.

Sense Biodetection Limited is a molecular diagnostics company focused on bringing tests to the True Point-of-Care. Sense was founded in 2014 by Harry Lamble and Ralph Lamble, who combined their respective expertise in molecular sciences and medical device design to realise their vision of empowering patients through decentralised testing. Sense is developing a new class of diagnostic product to break down the barriers that have led to the current model of centralised testing. Sense products are simple, ultra-rapid, handheld tests which remove the need for advanced hardware to determine a result. Sense operates from bespoke laboratory, with development and manufacturing facilities in Cambridg

claims.tagline: The fastest way to swap cryptocurrencies
claims.description: Shapeshift is the world’s first decentralized exchange platform for crypto assets like Bitcoin or Ether. With its core trading engine, Shapeshift allows for trustless and seamless swaps of crypto assets without being a custodian, thereby guaranteeing full user privacy and control over the respective asset. The company’s vision is to become the very epicenter of digital asset trading by launching further products such as its decentralized portfolio management tool Prism. Shapeshift was founded by Erik Voorhees, one of the leading Bitcoin pioneers and entrepreneurs.

claims.tagline: Developer-first security company that helps software-driven businesses develop fast and stay secure
claims.description: Snyk is a developer-first security company that helps software-driven businesses develop fast and stay secure. Snyk is the only solution that seamlessly and proactively finds and fixes vulnerabilities and license violations in open source dependencies and container images. Snyk’s solution is built on a comprehensive, proprietary vulnerability database, maintained by an expert security research team in Israel and London. With tight integration into existing developer workflows, source control (including GitHub, Bitbucket, GitLab), and CI/CD pipelines, Snyk enables efficient security workflows and reduces mean-time-to-fix.

TILT is social commerce platform aiming to create an immersive shopping experience for the next generation. On the mobile app, shoppers can jump into video and live stream rooms created by brands, invite friends, or chat with other shoppers. Brands can connect their stores to TILT in seconds, allowing them to create shoppable content by linking their products to rooms. By creating a social shopping experience, TILT aims to solve the boredom inherent in online shopping.

Digital working capital optimization through finetrading

Tradico offers a non-banking alternative for SMEs to improve working capital management and obtain liquidity. The company acts as an intermediary between buyer and seller, known as “finetrading”. Tradico pays the seller immediately, and grants the buyer an extended payment deadline. For this, Tradico charges interest. Because the seller is paid immediately, he will often grant a trade discount, which offsets the interest the buyer needs to pay to Tradico. The whole process happens online through their software system tradiCORE, which includes a user interface for the customer, automatic risk scoring and generation of credit limits for the customer.

claims.tagline: Empowering people to improve their health through convenient medical check-ups
claims.description: wellabe is one of the most exciting health start-ups in Europe. wellabe’s goal is to change corporate health management by helping employees to get a better understanding of their key health metrics through an individualized and digitalized medical check-up. wellabe developed a transportable lab which is capable of gathering and analyzing more than 60 key health factors within a 20 minute-procedure. Based on these data points users receive a face to face consultation with a medical doctor through the wellabe tele-doctor video solution. Users also get a calculated ‘body age’ as well as personalized prevention programs to enhance their current health situation within wellabe’s smartphone app.

The AI company started as a research project at The University of Oxford and Imperial College London by Leif-Nissen Lundbæk (Ph.D.) and Professor Michael Huth. Together with Felix Hahmann, they founded the tech company in 2017.

Their Small Language Model Xaynia leverages Natural Language Processing and offers business clients across different industries personalised semantic search and recommendations at scale. Xayn started as a research project at the University of Oxford and Imperial College London by Leif Nissen Lundbæk, PhD, and Professor Michael Huth. Together with Felix Hahmann, they founded the tech company in 2017. To this day, that academic vision remains with a workforce comprised of more than 35 % PhDs.
